verdict.rationale: Unleash's pricing page lists a dedicated dashboard for tracking stale feature flags, so the product itself covers the 'find stale flags' half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows code-reference scanning or any workflow that links a flag to where it is used in the codebase. missing for 10: code-reference discovery (locating where flags appear in source), a documented cleanup/removal workflow, in-depth docs on how stale status is determined, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase

citations.quote: Track stale feature flags with a dedicated dashboard
